The Destination

Bordered by a reserve, not a resort strip.

Castro Marim sits at the far eastern point of the Algarve — closer, in fact, to Spain than to Vilamoura.

It has stayed this way largely because of what surrounds it. Camaleão sits alongside the Sapal Reserve, one of the most authentic landscapes left in the Eastern Algarve, and a habitat set aside for the region's native chameleon — the species that gives the project its name. Parts of the site fall within Portugal's National Ecological Reserve and the Natura 2000 Network, a genuine conservation designation rather than a marketing gesture.

The sea is 600 metres away. Spain — Ayamonte, across the Guadiana — is 8 kilometres away, a proximity almost no other Algarve development can claim. Vila Real de Santo António, with its 18th-century Pombaline grid, is a ten-minute drive; Castro Marim's 13th-century castle sits above the marshes a few minutes further. Tavira is around 25–30 minutes west; Faro Airport is under an hour's drive.

Source: Camaleão brochure & masterplan, Terracota Capital, 2026.

At Your Own Pace

A slower register than the Golden Triangle.

We don't represent every development that asks. Camaleão suits a specific kind of buyer — someone who already knows the Algarve, who has seen Vilamoura and Quinta do Lago and wants something quieter, and who reads "understated" as a compliment rather than a shortcoming.

The material palette reflects that: terracotta tile underfoot, oak veneer at the doors, pools finished in dark green ceramic. Nothing here is chosen to photograph well from a drone — it's chosen to hold up to a decade of actual living by the sea.

Terracotta tile Oak wood veneer Ceramic pool cladding Natural stone
A Shared Vision

Designed by Luís Rebelo de Andrade.

One of Portugal's most awarded architects, known for work that treats luxury and well-being as the same problem rather than a trade-off. Camaleão is a consortium between Terracota Capital, which brought a close reading of the Portuguese market and a focus on the territory itself, and Vogue Homes, which brings over two decades in residential development, per the developer's own materials.

In 2025–2026, the project was recognised at the European Property Awards, in the Residential Development category for projects of twenty units or more — independent, third-party validation of the architecture and how it sits within its landscape.

Source: Camaleão brochure, European Property Awards 2025–2026 citation.

How the Purchase Works

Ownership, process, and what we won't claim.

Purchase process

A reservation, followed by a CPCV (promissory contract) and staged payments through to the Public Deed of purchase — standard under Portuguese property law, with the schedule above.

Ownership & title

Freehold ownership, registered under Portuguese law. Condominium and service charge figures are being confirmed with the developer and will be shared directly before you commit.

Residency & tax

Property investment in Portugal has not qualified for Golden Visa residency since October 2023 — Camaleão should be considered on its own merits, not as a residency route. We'd always recommend independent legal and tax advice alongside any purchase.

Frequently Asked

Direct answers, before you ask.

Does Camaleão qualify for Portugal's Golden Visa?

No. Property investment has not qualified for Golden Visa residency in Portugal since October 2023. Camaleão should be considered on its own merits as a home or investment, not as a residency route.

When is Camaleão completed, and can I rent it out?

Completion is scheduled for 2028. Two optional, professionally managed rental tiers are available for owners who want turnkey management; projected gross yields range from 5.5–8.1% depending on unit, based on the operator's stated seasonal occupancy assumptions — not a guarantee.

How far is Camaleão from the beach, from Spain, and from Faro Airport?

The sea is 600 metres away. Ayamonte, Spain, across the Guadiana, is 8 kilometres away. Faro Airport is under an hour's drive.

Who is developing and designing Camaleão?

A consortium of Terracota Capital and Vogue Homes, with architecture by Luís Rebelo de Andrade — recognised at the European Property Awards 2025–2026 in the Residential Development category for projects of twenty units or more.

What does the payment structure look like?

20% at CPCV signature (including a €25,000 reservation), 10% at 12 months, 10% at 18 months, and 60% at Public Deed.

Is Camaleão near a protected nature reserve?

Yes — it borders the Reserva Natural do Sapal de Castro Marim e Vila Real de Santo António, and part of the site falls within Portugal's National Ecological Reserve and the Natura 2000 Network.
